01 / THE OPPORTUNITY

A great conversation
deserves a better
next step.

Career fairs move fast. Candidate information shouldn’t get left behind.

Talent IQ brings candidate profiles, resumes, and recruiter notes into one shared workflow—so teams can pick up where the conversation ended.

01Capture with less friction

QR-based check-in, directly in the browser.

02Keep the context together

One candidate record, from intake to review.

03Support human judgment

Source-linked drafts, verified by a recruiter.

01 / CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE

A handshake.
A scan.
A connection.

Candidates check in through a QR code. No installation. Just a responsive intake that captures their profile, skills, and resume in one place.

THE HANDOFFA shared candidate record, ready for recruiter review.
02 / RECRUITER EXPERIENCE

Less scattered.
More connected.

Search, filter, and compare candidate records. Capture notes, update follow-up status, and export a consistent view of the recruiting pipeline.

THE WORKSPACEProfiles, resumes, and conversation notes—together.
03 / ASSISTED REVIEW

AI drafts.
People decide.

Summary drafts reference candidate profiles, resumes, and recruiter notes. Source checks and recruiter approval support an evidence-first review.

THE BOUNDARYNo candidate ranking, scoring, or hiring recommendations.

Live-model evaluation is still pending. AI generation requires configured server credentials.

03 / FROM PROTOTYPE TO PROOF

A clear route
to measurable value.

The next investment is validation: test the workflow with representative recruiters, measure the difference, and prepare for a sponsor-approved pilot.

01 / DEMONSTRATED

Connected foundation

Shared intake and review, synchronized records, workflow updates, and deterministic AI output checks.

02 / NEXT

Prove the experience

Run the comparative study. Measure capture time, review time, record completeness, and draft correction effort.

03 / BEFORE REAL DATA

Prepare the pilot

Add recruiter authentication, define data governance, evaluate live AI, and complete accessibility checks.

Evidence, before claims.The comparative study is designed but has not been executed. Efficiency gains and live AI accuracy have not yet been measured.
